name: Fathom
desc: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, highlights, and generates AI summaries and action items from your meetings. Integrate with workflows to react to meeting events and retrieve meeting data.

actions.name: getRecordingSummary
actions.description: Get the AI-generated summary of a meeting recording. Works with both OAuth and API key connections.

actions.name: getRecordingTranscript
actions.description: Get the transcript of a meeting recording. Works with both OAuth and API key connections.

actions.name: listMeetings
actions.description: List meetings with optional filters. Follows every page unless you set Max Pages.

actions.name: findTeam
actions.description: List the teams in your Fathom account, one page at a time.

actions.name: findTeamMember
actions.description: List the members of your Fathom account, optionally only those of one team. To look up one person, use Find Team Member by Email.

actions.name: find_team_member_by_email
actions.description: Look up one Fathom team member by their exact email address.

actions.name: list_meeting_types
actions.description: List the meeting types defined in your Fathom organization.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: List the users of your Fathom account with their status and permissions. Needs an account admin connection.

actions.name: request_recording_download
actions.description: Ask Fathom to prepare a video or audio file of a recording. Then use Get Recording Download to get the file link.

actions.name: get_recording_download
actions.description: Check a download started with Request Recording Download and get the file link once it is ready.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: newRecording
triggers.description: Fires when Fathom finishes processing a new meeting recording. Turn on at least one of the Include options.
